summary: Consolidate supplier quotes in the #rfq-stainless-bottle Slack thread and submit a structured answer.json. Capacity checks are capability units: plumbing + protocol-compliance fold into setup_gate (R2), and each real sourcing competence is one check that AND-aggregates its atomic field predicates (R4).
